text: ポケモンが　おぼえている　わざのうち　１つの　ＰＰの　さいだいちを　すこし　あげる。

structure.jp: ポケモンが　おぼえている　わざのうち
structure.en: among the moves a Pokémon knows

structure.jp: １つの　ＰＰの　さいだいちを

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンが　おぼえている　わざ
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' or 'which' in English. ポケモンが　おぼえている　わざ = 'the moves a Pokémon knows'.

patterns.name: 〜のうち
patterns.explanation: のうち after a group means 'out of' or 'among' that group. わざのうち　１つ = 'one out of the moves'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows a lasting state that came from an earlier action: it learned the move and still has it. おぼえている = 'knows'.
